{"action": "sql", "sql": "WITH latest_assessments AS (
  SELECT a.employee_id,
         a.skill_id,
         a.score,
         e.job_title,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.employee_id, a.skill_id ORDER BY a.assessed_on DESC) AS rn
  FROM skills.assessments a
  JOIN skills.employees e ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id
  WHERE e.left_on IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la.employee_id) AS employees_below_target
FROM latest_assessments la
JOIN skills.role_targets rt ON rt.job_title = la.job_title AND rt.skill_id = la.skill_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND (la.score + 1) < rt.target_score;"}

decision.sql:
WITH latest_assessments AS (
  SELECT a.employee_id,
         a.skill_id,
         a.score,
         e.job_title,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.employee_id, a.skill_id ORDER BY a.assessed_on DESC) AS rn
  FROM skills.assessments a
  JOIN skills.employees e ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id
  WHERE e.left_on IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la.employee_id) AS employees_below_target
FROM latest_assessments la
JOIN skills.role_targets rt ON rt.job_title = la.job_title AND rt.skill_id = la.skill_id
WHERE la.rn = 1

    date_trunc('month', o.ordered_on)::date AS month_start,
    SUM(ol.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'completed') AS revenue
  FROM sales.orders o
  JOIN sales.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.ordered_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.ordered_on)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT generate_series('2025-01-01'::date, '2025-12-01'::date, '1 month')::date AS month_start
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    am.month_start,
    COALESCE(mr.revenue, 0) AS revenue
  FROM all_months am
  LEFT JOIN monthly_revenue mr ON mr.month_start = am.month_start
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_revenue
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  (revenue - COALESCE(prev_revenue, 0)) AS mom_change_usd
FROM with_lag
WHERE month_start >= '2025-02-01' AND month_start <= '2025-12-01'
ORDER BY month_start;"}

{"action": "sql", "sql": "WITH yearly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)::int AS year,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price * (1 - ol.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue
  FROM sales.order_lines ol
  JOIN sales.orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN sales.products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY p.category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ordered_on)
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2024,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN revenue END) AS revenue_2025
  FROM yearly_revenue
  GROUP BY category
),
growth AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    revenue_2024,
    revenue_2025,
    (revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) / NULLIF(revenue_2024, 0) AS growth_rate
  FROM pivot
  WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
)
SELECT category
FROM growth
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;"}
